{{Top|leg}}
'''Warrior''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] rank and specialization. It was one of three categories of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] skill offered to offworld clients by the Nightsister clan, the other two being those of '''''[[Hunter (Nightsister)/Legends|hunter]]''''' and '''''[[Shadow killer/Legends|shadow killer]]'''''. All [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] mercenaries, which included those from the ranks of both the Nightsisters and the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]], were chosen from the successful endurance of the trials of [[Selection/Legends|Selection]].<ref name=":0">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

A warrior wore the cuffs and shoulder armor of all successful survivors of [[Selection/Legends|the Crucible]], and bore weapons (such as [[Pike/Legends|pikes]]) that were infused with "powerful [[magick]]" and could cut through any substance.<ref name=":0" />

"'''Transformed warriors'''" were also created by an expert [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|shaman's]] skilled use of magick and green [[Spirit ichor/Legends|spirit ichor]]. To achieve this, the augmentative skills of a full [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of Nightsister ''crafters'' was also required. Ichor was conjured through the magicks of the [[Son/Legends|Fanged God]] to transform a warrior into an avatar of primal anger; the rawest hatred was channeled to siphon the energies into hulking muscle and bone. The resultant warrior was massive, standing "a head taller, boasting a broad chest and spine-crushing arms."<ref name=":0" />

[[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], for example, was a transformed warrior; the proud [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] grew a crown of horns "to rival that of a verne buck in autumn."<ref name=":0" /><ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref>
